Creator and business flows in one marketplace

The project brings together profile creation, campaign posting, campaign discovery, mutual matching, messaging, reporting, account controls, subscription work, and Stripe marketplace payments inside a React Native and Expo app.

Description

Stitch is a personal mobile app project focused on creator-brand collaboration. Creators can build a profile, show their work, add social accounts, set compensation expectations, browse campaigns, and swipe on opportunities they want to explore. Businesses can create a profile, post campaigns with images and budget details, discover creators, and start conversations after a mutual match.

The portfolio version presents Stitch as both a product and a build story: a marketplace interface, a two-sided user model, mobile-first onboarding, protected account flows, and release work that has already reached iOS App Store approval.

Problem Statement

Small businesses often need creator partnerships, but finding the right person can turn into scattered outreach, uncertain fit, and long message threads before either side knows whether a collaboration makes sense. Creators face the same friction from the other direction: useful campaign opportunities are difficult to find, compare, and manage in one place.

Stitch tackles that problem by making discovery feel familiar and lightweight. A swipe-based flow helps both sides signal interest quickly, while matching and messaging give them a clearer path from first impression to collaboration details.

Process

1

Defined the two-sided marketplace model around creators, businesses, profiles, campaigns, discovery, and messaging.

2

Built mobile onboarding and account flows so each user type could enter the app with the right profile data and permissions.

3

Designed campaign creation and editing with images, budgets, dates, descriptions, and business context.

4

Connected swipe discovery, mutual matching, and chat so creators and businesses could move from browsing to conversation.

5

Added product readiness work around content reporting, account deletion, subscriptions, Stripe marketplace payments, and app store release requirements.

Full Results

The strongest result is a working creator marketplace product with real mobile release momentum. Stitch is structured around practical collaboration workflows: creators can present themselves and discover campaigns, businesses can publish opportunities and review creators, and both sides can match, chat, and move toward paid work.
